'''Orbital sensor droids''' were employed by [[Lant Mining Corporation]] to keep watch over the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Gart]] in the [[Demar system/Legends|Demar system]]. Any violations of Gart's [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] were immediately reported to LMC.<ref name="Flashpoint">''[[Flashpoint! Brak Sector]]''</ref>
